svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 12/12 Library Window (Common)
svg.desc: Heads down in the reading room, while outside the window the fog moves over the treetops. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
